- Balancing on the war hammer and the double axe.

notes.title: Update 07/06/2017 ( New map, cleaner fights, and more)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28925045/d7c139cb4e1a58bcf521aa9f2bbb0ccadb0d8832.jpg[/img]

- New map: Snow Castle
- Two one-handed weapons nerfed
- Stamina system to avoid "spamming", especially with two one-handed weapons; the screen's edges become darker and the damage inflicted are reduced when the stamina is low
- Better behavior of the AI, they now speak, move more naturally and don't stay too close to the player
- The collisions were fixed on several maps
- Attic and Expedition (boat) are temporarily pulled from the game due to performance and gameplay issues
- Tutorial text corrected
- The morning star requires more velocity to inflict heavy damage
- Crash during the matchmaking fixed
- Improved lighting in the tavern
- Better attack blocking system to allow efficient defensive behavior
- Minor overall graphics improvement
- 180° tracking on first launch issue fixed

Hope to meet you soon in a fight!

notes.title: Update 27/05/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28925045/1c82c1f8910cdcbbd974a21202b08fabf91c76a6.jpg[/img]


- Spear is now more balanced and with better physical behavior.
- People you played with are now registered as "played with" on Steam, so that you can add them as friends.
- Collisions between player are more consistant.
- Return to customization bug fixed.
- Weapon unlock bug fixed.
- The music in the character creation now starts everytime.
- The occasional crash during the matchmaking is fixed.
- It is not possible to cause damage through a shield anymore.
